title: Replace config panics with typed errors
task: parse_config in src/lib.rs panics on bad input. Change it to pub fn parse_config(text: &str) -> Result<Config, ConfigError> that never panics, keeping Config unchanged. Add a public enum ConfigError at the crate root deriving Debug, Clone, PartialEq and Eq, implementing std::fmt::Display and std::error::Error, with exactly these variants: Syntax { line: usize }, UnknownKey { line: usize, key: String }, DuplicateKey { line: usize, key: String }, InvalidValue { line: usize, key: String, value: String } and MissingKey(String). line is the 1-based line number in text. Lines are trimmed; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Any other line without '=' is Syntax. Otherwise split at the first '=' and trim key and value. Known keys are host, port and retries; any other key (including an empty one) is UnknownKey. A key already set by an earlier line is DuplicateKey at the later line. host must be non-empty, port must be a u16 from 1 to 65535 and retries must be a u32; otherwise InvalidValue with the trimmed key and value. Lines are checked in order and the first error is returned. After all lines, a missing host is MissingKey("host"), else a missing port is MissingKey("port"). retries defaults to 3. Update the existing tests and add tests for the errors.
